description: Main React component for a lightweight note management SPA, including note CRUD operations, state management, and UI rendering.

methods.name: uuidFallback
methods.description: Generates a fallback unique identifier based on timestamp and random number.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a value is null, undefined, or whitespace.

methods.name: normalizeNote
methods.description: Normalizes backend note object into a consistent shape with id, title, and content.

methods.name: normalizeMaybeSingleNote
methods.description: Normalizes backend response for a single note, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing notes, UI, and interactions.

methods.name: startNewNote
methods.description: Initiates creation of a new note, resets draft fields.

methods.name: startEditSelected
methods.description: Enables editing of the selected note.

methods.name: cancelEditing
methods.description: Cancels editing/creating mode, returns to view mode.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches and normalizes notes from backend, updates state.

methods.name: onSaveDraft
methods.description: Saves current draft as new or updated note, refreshes list.

methods.name: onConfirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the selected note.
